stem: Which idea is supported by information in BOTH selections “Dive into a Sunken Museum” and “A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt”?
instruction: Use “Dive into a Sunken Museum” and “A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: It is people’s responsibility to take care of the environment.

options.label: B
options.text: People can experience beautiful sights while exploring nature.

options.label: C
options.text: It is important for people to teach themselves new skills.

options.label: D
options.text: Great wealth should be shared with others.
